home.about.5.text: Celebration of Life - Ride & Run for Breast Cancer is a joyful community event created to honor breast cancer survivors, encourage early detection, and raise funds for breast cancer research. The event is presented by Celebration of Life, Ride and Run for Breast Cancer, Inc., a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization (pending).

home.about.8.text: Proceeds from Celebration of Life - Ride & Run for Breast Cancer benefit two leading cancer institutions: Moffitt Cancer Center and UF Health Cancer Institute. Funds raised through the event will help advance breast cancer research, improve treatment, and bring new hope to individuals and families affected by breast cancer.

home.our-story-section.3.text: The Celebration of Life was founded on a simple, powerful promise:

home.our-story-section.4.text: to unite Florida's vibrant horse country and athletic community in the fight against breast cancer. Hosted at Ocala's historic Florida Horse Park, our annual Ride & Run brings families together on the trails and track to honor survivors, remember loved ones, and fund breast cancer research. Every registration, every sponsor, and every single stride moves us closer to a cure.

home.our-story-section.7.text: "We are grateful for community partners like Celebration of Life, Ride and Run for Breast Cancer who work so hard to organize events and activities that support innovative research and treatment at Moffitt Cancer Center. You strive with us to create a better future without cancer. Thank you so much for your support!"

home.our-story-section.9.text: Executive Vice President and President, Moffitt Foundation

home.our-story-section.11.text: "Each year, thousands of individuals and their loved ones face a breast cancer diagnosis, reminding us of the urgent need for continued prevention, early detection, and treatment innovations. Your support of the Celebration of Life, Ride and Run for Breast Cancer advances breast cancer research at the UF Health Cancer Institute. Breakthroughs in digital imaging, targeted therapies, and tailored survivorship care can transform lives, and your support helps make this work possible. Thank you for helping us move research forward and bring new hope to those affected by breast cancer."

home.why-started-section.3.text: "While dealing with breast cancer, I dreamed about creating this joyous event as a way of fighting back and creating awareness. There is life after breast cancer, if diagnosed early.

home.why-started-section.4.text: "Fear" is a four-letter word that keeps many women from getting annual mammograms, doing self-exams or going to their doctors. Many walk around for years with lumps they can feel or are even visible. By allowing "fear" to rule their lives, they lessen their chances of survival. We hope they will see from the breast cancer survivors today, we are leading happy, healthy and productive lives.

home.why-started-section.5.text: The "Celebration of Life" event honors the courage and strength of each breast cancer survivor throughout this life-changing experience. Dr. Bernie Siegel wrote, "Cancer is a gift." It was not readily apparent to me, but as time went on I began to understand what he meant. My gifts are the extraordinary people who continue to come into my life. They show me kindness, compassion and love as I have never known before. And it is because of them, my life has new meaning.

home.why-started-section.8.text: Celebration of Life, Ride and Run for Breast Cancer, Inc.

home.activities.4.text: Bring Your Own Horse Poker Ride

home.activities.5.text: Bring your horse and enjoy a five-mile poker ride along the Florida Greenway. The ride is open from 10:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. Minimum age is ten years old. Riders between the ages of ten and fifteen must be accompanied by their parent or responsible adult. Riders will collect their poker hand along the route while enjoying one of Ocala’s beautiful equestrian trails.

home.activities.7.text: Every horse must have a current negative Coggins certificate. Please bring proof with you; it will be checked when you arrive.

home.activities.8.text: Riders age 15 and younger must wear a properly fitted riding helmet, as required by Florida law.

home.activities.9.text: All riders must wear riding boots, paddock shoes, or footwear with an adequate heel. Open-toed shoes are not permitted.

home.activities.10.text: Backpacks may not be worn during the trail ride.

home.activities.14.text: Enjoy a scenic two-mile trail at your own pace between 10:00 a.m. and 1:00 p.m. This is a family-oriented activity, not a timed race. Run, walk, or bring your ruck pack and join the Ruck Walk.

home.activities.15.text: Parents or guardians must accompany participants age 15 and younger.

home.activities.16.text: Strollers for young children are welcome.

home.activities.17.text: Bicycles, scooters and motorized scooters, and motorized carts are not permitted on the route.

home.activities.18.text: Water stations will be available along the trail.

home.activities.19.text: We recommend wearing sunscreen, comfortable shoes, and a hat.

home.activities.20.text: Veterans, bring your ruck packs and join us!

home.activities.23.text: Poker Ride participants must enter through the Florida Horse Park entrance on Highway 475.

home.activities.24.text: You will be directed to horse-trailer parking directly across from the trail entrance. Parking is free. Please be ready to show your registration and current negative Coggins certificate.
